solution:
**GIVEN:**

Different types of geysers sold by a company over six years 

**CALCULATION:**

Total sales of geyser A of all the six years = ( 75 + 100 + 105 + 100 + 95 + 85 ) = 560 

Total sales of geyser B of all the six years = ( 122 + 102 + 108 + 189 + 123 + 145 ) = 789 

Total sales of geyser C of all the six years = (103 + 103 + 112 + 123 + 102 + 134 ) = 677 

Total sales of geyser D of all the six years = ( 98 + 112 + 109 + 102 + 124 + 134 ) = 679 

Total sales of geyser E of all the six years = ( 95 + 102 + 108 + 122 + 124 + 145 ) = 696 

So, total sales of geyser A is minimum among all the types
